name: Timemore Sculptor 064S
details: Electric single-dose grinder with 64 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–2.9, moka pot 2.5–8.5, AeroPress 1.7–14.5, V60 3.3–9.3, filter coffee machine 1.3–13.3, French press 9.1–16, cold brew 11.3–16; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
